caption: The drawing depicts two views of an elaborate gown, both on headless dress forms. The dress features a fitted bodice with a deep, rounded neckline that is trimmed with lace. The bodice is primarily a light lavender or lilac color with shiny, satin-like texture and darker purple accents, and it has short, lace-trimmed sleeves adorned with floral or ruffled embellishments. The skirt is floor-length with an overlay of a pale, patterned fabric in light pinks, creams, and hints of yellow or green, displaying a large floral or damask motif. The front view reveals a split overskirt trimmed with beaded or jeweled edges and decorated with a bow detail near the hem. The draped, trailing train of the gown is a sheer, lavender fabric that extends behind the dress. The back view shows how the bodice fits closely to the form and how the sheer, flowing train attaches at the back of the waist, cascading to the floor with gentle folds and ruffled edges. The entire composition is rendered with delicate, fine lines and soft washes of pastel color, giving the fabric a luminous effect against a plain beige or off-white background.
title: Dress
